answer: The forge chain binds each identity to one link of real work. Each morning the forge opens; a newcomer locks a $5 bond, takes one blank, and forges one link before dusk. Two smiths at the vertex fit it in the chain and mark it in the atlas; a link that does not fit, a copied blank, or a link forged twice burns the bond. One honest agent spends an hour and $5; a farm faking a hundred must forge a hundred links by one dusk and lock $500.
